h: Strengthening the Oral Torah Through Teshuvah and Heavenly Crowns

p: in which is the life of all
צְרוֹר הַחַיִּים אֵת ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ (שְׁמוּאֵל א כה, כט)
"the bundle of life with Hashem your God" (Shmuel I 25:29)
the "es" that is subordinate to the Name Havayah,
that is, the attribute of Malchus;
and it is the Shabbos of Shabbos eve,
as is written in the holy Zohar.
that from there all the souls fly forth;
and this is "in which is the life of all."
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (בַּמִּדְבָּר יד, יז)
in the manner of what is said (Bamidbar 14:17):
"And now, may the strength of my Lord be great";
and this is the attribute of Malchus,
which is written with the Name Adnus.
it is the aspect of Keser Elyon,
which is the crown of Malchus.
tying crowns onto the letters…" and so on;
"He said to him: You should have helped Me.
he said to Him…" and so on.
of the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
"He said to Him: Who holds back…" and so on;
"there is one man…" and so on,
שֶׁעָתִיד לִדְרוֹשׁ עַל כָּל קוֹץ וָקוֹץ
"who will expound upon each and every crownlet
And likewise we find in the Gemara (Megillah 28b):
"And one who makes use of the crown…" and so on
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh.
And this is the meaning of
"He said to him: You should have helped Me":
שֶׁזֶּה הוּא כֹּחַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
for this is the power of Torah she'b'al peh
as it were, "Come and give Me light,"
like the parable of the blind man and the sighted one
"And now, may the strength of my Lord be great"
which is the attribute of Malchus;
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרִינָן לָהּ
"the mouth — we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
And this pasuk was written in the Torah
after the sin of the spies;
and he said to Him "and now,"
and "'and now' means nothing but teshuvah"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כא, ו)
for certainly they would do teshuvah;
"Here we are, and we will go up…"
Only the decree was not annulled,
that had an oath with it
"may the strength of my Lord be great":
that the power of the Name Adnus
which is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
for the Torah she'b'al peh was needed,
And the yud of "yigdal" is large,
and the crownlet on the yud
And this is "as You have spoken, saying":
denotes the aspect of the Written Torah,
as is written in the Gemara (Makkos 11a);
is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
"My saying shall flow like the dew";
and say to him: When you kindle";
and we said that this is
about the illumination of Torah she'b'al peh
regarding the body of the mitzvah of kindling,
which is from the Written Torah,
הוּא עַל כֹּחַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
is about the power of Torah she'b'al peh,
"And now, may the strength of my Lord be great":
the power of Torah she'b'al peh,
that the power of Torah she'b'al peh will be
like the power of the Written Torah,
in the matter of the test of the spies,
and they are called in the parshah
as is written in the holy Zohar
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא בְּהַר, חֵלֶק ג קט, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
and here, in the tenth test,
And in the Gemara the expression is
"immediately he said to Him, 'And now, may it be great'";
for since Hashem Yisbarach said to him,
in that He was tying crowns…
'And now, may the strength of my Lord be great'";
Moshe Rabbeinu said to Him then, right away,
"May the strength of my Lord be great":
that is, the power of Torah she'b'al peh;
only, the pasuk was written afterward,
is from the dew of Atika,
as it says, "My saying shall flow like the dew,"
as has been explained several times.
